findings.post_fix_command: TZ=UTC JWT_SECRET=<ephemeral> npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 tests/inventory-position-routes.test.ts tests/data-2-transaction-numeric-guards.test.ts tests/idempotency.test.ts tests/inventory-transaction-conservation.test.ts
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: 4 files, 32 tests; final route file contains 9 passing tests and final full backend passed 2010 tests.

findings.requirement_or_entry: generic inbound PUT versus dedicated transfer ownership and 70/30 conservation
findings.pre_fix_reproduction: On afff326e, completing a pending inbound_records row with type=transfer through PUT /api/v1/inbound/:id returned 200, changed stock from 0 to 5, created only a target inbound allocation, and made no source deduction. An ordinary pending inbound could also be retagged to transfer in the request.
findings.fix_path: Reject existing or requested reserved inbound types before idempotency replay or planning; apply the same route-ownership boundary to generic check-deletable and cancel/delete paths.
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: 1 file, 13 tests; both pending-transfer and direct-to-transfer cases return 409 ROUTE_OWNERSHIP_VIOLATION with zero position, stock, allocation, type, or status writes. Final full backend: 156 files and 2014 tests PASS.
findings.residual_boundary: Dedicated transfer cancellation remains in the separate G2 compensation chain boundary.

findings.requirement_or_entry: known location capacity must block additions
findings.pre_fix_reproduction: POST /api/v1/locations with capacity=0 returned 201 but stored 999999 because capacity || 999999 treated zero as missing; a subsequent one-unit inbound succeeded.
findings.fix_path: Normalize capacity once, default only when undefined, preserve numeric zero, and pass the normalized value to the insert.
findings.post_fix_command: TZ=UTC npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 tests/inventory-position-routes.test.ts tests/p1-12-06-locations.test.ts
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: zero is stored exactly and the first addition returns 422 LOCATION_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED with zero position/cache writes; related location regressions pass.
findings.residual_boundary: Real-database capacity values and concurrent production writes were not accessed or load-tested.

findings.requirement_or_entry: position-derived inventory read model status filters
findings.pre_fix_reproduction: GET /api/v1/inventory?status=low-stock returned 500 because HAVING was appended to a non-aggregate SELECT; expired and expiring-soon shared the malformed query shape, and low-stock still used the stock cache.
findings.fix_path: Move status predicates into WHERE, derive low stock from summed positions, and qualify expiry batches by positive position facts for both count and list queries.
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: low-stock, expired, and expiring-soon each return 200 and include the seeded position-backed material; final full backend passes 2014 tests.
findings.residual_boundary: Frontend rendering of the position-expanded response remains outside this backend-only slice.

findings.requirement_or_entry: material packaging conversion must share the planner safe four-decimal domain
findings.pre_fix_reproduction: Creating a material with unitsPerPackage=0.00001 returned 201 and stored the value; its next inbound failed 409 INVENTORY_LEDGER_CORRUPT because the planner cannot represent five decimal places. Fresh materials DDL also accepted the poison value.
findings.fix_path: Reject POST/PUT conversion values outside the positive safe four-decimal range and align fresh materials DDL checks with the already strict additive-column definition.
findings.post_fix_command: TZ=UTC npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 tests/inventory-position-routes.test.ts tests/inventory-position-schema.test.ts tests/data-1-numeric-guards.test.ts
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: POST and PUT return 400 INVALID_PARAMETER for 0.00001, direct fresh-schema insertion is rejected, valid numeric guards and schema migration tests pass.
findings.residual_boundary: Pre-existing real databases are not rewritten in this task; direct legacy corruption continues to fail closed.

findings.fix_path: Preserve the explicit retired-BOM type rejection, then load the record and enforce completed-state G2 before replacement-item validation.
findings.post_fix_command: TZ=UTC npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 tests/inventory-position-routes.test.ts tests/issue-112-business-month.test.ts tests/outbound-bom-retirement.test.ts
findings.post_fix_result: PASS: malformed and well-shaped completed PUTs return 409 COMPENSATION_CHAIN_REQUIRED with zero writes; Issue #112 remains 9/9 and retired BOM type remains 400 INVALID_PARAMETER.

findings.requirement_or_entry: position-derived inventory expired and expiring-soon filters must match the returned earliest live batch classification
findings.pre_fix_reproduction: On fixed candidate 5b298630, a material with one positive-position expired batch and one positive-position batch expiring in 10 days was returned by GET /api/v1/inventory?status=expiring-soon even though the same response row reported status=expired and the expired batch expiry. The added RED failed at inventory-position-routes.test.ts:422 with expected false but received true.
findings.fix_path: Changed both expired and expiring-soon predicates to compare the same earliest positive-position batch expiry used by the response, making the categories mutually exclusive, and retained a two-batch expired-plus-soon regression.
findings.post_fix_command: TZ=UTC npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 tests/inventory-position-routes.test.ts -t 'keeps inventory status filters'; then the 2-file focused command and the final full backend command in final_candidate_gates
findings.post_fix_result: Targeted GREEN: 1 selected test passed; author focused GREEN: 2 files and 19 tests passed; final full backend GREEN: exit 0, 156 files and 2014 tests passed, duration 220.85s. Independent directed review on cf15d478 also passed fixed-archive probes and 2 files / 19 tests in 3.06s.
findings.residual_boundary: Frontend presentation and timezone behavior outside the server's established date contract remain outside this backend slice.
